note: top navigation bar -- platform's own interface including main menu, logo, search, and user links
search box -- platform's own interface and controls
user links menu -- platform's own interface for site support, create account, login
TOC header label and unpin button -- platform's own interface controls
appearance settings -- platform's own interface for font size, width, and theme controls
left navigation tabs -- platform's own interface for article and talk page links
right navigation tabs and page tools -- platform's own interface for view, source, history, and tools
footer -- platform's own interface with site links, copyright, and legal links
language selector -- platform's own interface for interlanguage links
page title bar -- renders: language selector controls; the article title heading is subtracted
site subtitle -- operator-authored copy such as 'From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia'
page indicators -- operator-authored interface for protected page and spoken article icons
category links -- operator-defined taxonomy terms for article categories
sister sites box -- operator-defined list of Wikimedia project links
spoken Wikipedia section -- operator-authored interface for audio player and disclaimer
navbox navbar controls -- platform's own interface for view, talk, edit links
